entries.chinese: 行业 部门 领域 区域
entries.definition: a part or division of an area especially part of the economy
entries.example: Service sector jobs, such as restaurant jobs, are often low paying.

entries.chinese: 可用的 可获得的 有空的 有闲暇的 未婚的 单身的
entries.definition: If something is available, it exists and you can use it
entries.example: These forms are available from the local office.

entries.chinese: 财政的 金融的 有钱的 已缴费的 财务状况 金融公司股票
entries.definition: A financial problem, issue, activity or other thing is about money or business
entries.example: Our sales are down and we have serious financial problems.

entries.chinese: 步骤 程序 变化过程 过程 进程 制作方法
entries.definition: a series of steps that you take for a particular purpose
entries.example: Let us look at the factors considered during the formal decision-making process.

entries.chinese: 单独的 个别的 个人的 独特的 与众不同的 个人
entries.definition: An individual person or thing is looked at separately from others
entries.example: This office assists whole families rather than individual family members.

entries.chinese: 明确的 具体的 特定的 特有的 独特的 有特殊功能的
entries.definition: If you talk about a specific idea, person, group, or thing, you mean that it is different from or more interesting than other things like it
entries.example: The interviewer uses a checklist to make sure that specific areas are covered.

entries.chinese: 准则 原则 道义 正直 基本原则 基本法则
entries.definition: Principles are personal rules that tell you what is right and wrong
entries.example: It goes against my principles to ignore her.

entries.chinese: 估计 判断 评价 估价 估价单 看法
entries.definition: a judgement of a size, value, amount, cost, etc, which is based on incomplete information
entries.example: British Telecom will give you an estimate of the cost before doing any work.

entries.chinese: 变量
entries.definition: The plural form of variable; more than one (kind of) variable
entries.example: Which seats to select and which snacks to buy are the variables to consider when going to the movies.

entries.chinese: 方法 办法 条理 体验派表演方法
entries.definition: If you use a method to achieve a goal, then you use a planned process
entries.example: My preferred method for contacting friends overseas is on the Internet.

entries.chinese: 数据 资料 数据资料 驮太 达塔
entries.definition: information, such as facts, numbers, photographs, etc
entries.example: A study using experimental data from ten schools found no difference between methods.

entries.chinese: 研究 探讨 研究工作 调查工作 探索 为 收集资料
entries.definition: the process or result of trying to find an answer by reading, interviewing, watching, or doing experiments
entries.example: We've been conducting research into the reason for the changes in these fish.

entries.chinese: 合同 契约 暗杀协议 定约墩数 婚约 订婚
entries.definition: a legal agreement to trade goods, services and/or property
entries.example: My father's employment contract is for forty years.

entries.chinese: 自然环境 生态环境 周围状况 条件 工作平台 软件包
entries.definition: the natural world: forests, rivers, grasslands, oceans, etc
entries.example: We have to do more to protect the environment from pollution.

entries.chinese: 出口 传播 输出 导出 出口物 输出品
entries.definition: If you export something, you send it out of the country, usually for business purposes
entries.example: Canada will export up to 450,000 barrels per day of crude oil to China.

entries.chinese: 来源 出处 原因 根源 消息人士 信息来源
entries.definition: If you source something, then you obtain or receive it
entries.example: XYZ company can't supply these parts anymore, so we need to find a new source.

entries.chinese: 评估 评价 估价 估计
entries.definition: An assessment of a person, idea, skill, process, etc
entries.example: The results of your recent job assessment are excellent.

entries.chinese: 政策 方针 原则 策略 保险单
entries.definition: an official rule or idea that explain how to act in certain situations
entries.example: The government is suggesting a significant change in economic policy.

entries.chinese: 被识别的 经鉴定的 被认同的 鉴定 辨认
entries.definition: The past tense and past participle of identify
entries.example: The police took fingerprints and identified the body.

entries.chinese: 创造 创建 设计 创作 造成 引起
entries.definition: If you create something, you make or invent it
entries.example: Wiktionary editors create Wiktionary entries.

entries.chinese: 导出的 衍生的 派生的 从 衍生出 源于 得到
entries.definition: The past tense and past participle of derive
entries.example: Many students derived enormous satisfaction from the course..

entries.chinese: 因素 做代理商 分解 的因子 把 作为因素考虑
entries.definition: The plural form of factor; more than one (kind of) factor
entries.example: The rise in crime is mainly due to social and economic factors.

entries.chinese: 手续 步骤 程序 外科手术 应用程式
entries.definition: a particular way of doing something
entries.example: We have decided on new hiring procedures for employees.

entries.chinese: 定义 释义 榜样 典范 清晰 清晰度
entries.definition: an explanation of the meaning of a word
entries.example: The sentence before this one is a definition.

entries.chinese: 假定 假设 认为 装出 做出 承担
entries.definition: If you assume something, you think or believe something without having enough information to know that it's true
entries.example: Oh, hello. I assume you're the new student, are you?

entries.chinese: 学说 理论 原理 观点 见解
entries.definition: an idea that tries to explain an observation
entries.example: Nobody has disproved Einstein's theory of general relativity.

entries.chinese: 好处 益处 救济金 补助金 额外奖励 保险金
entries.definition: something good that comes from something else
entries.example: It was her idea, but she received no benefit from the new program.

entries.chinese: 根据 证明 证据 证词 迹象 痕迹
entries.definition: facts or observations that support an idea
entries.example: The gun is evidence that professor Pickle killed Mr. Mustard.

entries.chinese: 确立已久的 早已投入使用的 资深的 知名的 已生根的 长势良好的
entries.definition: If an institution, system, etc
entries.example: The fact that the earth is a ball is well established.

entries.chinese: 专家 权威人士 行政管理机构 权力 权限 权威
entries.definition: To have authority means to have the power to make a decision
entries.example: This judge has the authority to throw you in jail.

entries.chinese: 重大的 主要的 严重的 大调的 大音阶的 大的
entries.definition: A major change, problem, event, etc
entries.example: Tom Cruise had a major part in the movie. He directed it and acted in it as the main character.

entries.chinese: 议题 问题 债券 争点 发行 分发
entries.definition: The plural form of issue; more than one (kind of) issue
entries.example: Some important issues were raised at the meeting.

entries.chinese: 劳动 任务 工作 劳工 工人 劳动力
entries.definition: the work that people do, usually lifting, moving, building, etc
entries.example: The cost of labour is higher than the cost of building materials.

entries.chinese: 发生 存在 出现 产生
entries.definition: If something occurs, it happens
entries.example: Over the summer a change occurred in my friend’s behaviour.

entries.chinese: 经济的 经济学的 有利可图的 节约的
entries.definition: About or relating to the economy, business, money, etc
entries.example: Some people are in economic trouble and have difficulty paying their bills.

entries.chinese: 复杂的 与 关系密切的 专心于 的 忙于 的 卷入的 参与的
entries.definition: The past tense and past participle of involve
entries.example: The processes involved in word recognition are rather different for spoken and printed words.

entries.chinese: 百分之 部分 百分之 的 以百分之 地 每一百中有 地
entries.definition: You use percent show the number of parts out of a hundred
entries.example: The cost of gas has increased seven percent in the last month.

entries.chinese: 解释 理解 表演 演奏 艺术处理 口译
entries.definition: an attempt to understand something
entries.example: Weather forecasters use a lot of data, but the interpretation of the data is very difficult.

entries.chinese: 始终如一的 一贯的 持续的 连续的 固守的 坚持的
entries.definition: If something is consistent, it is regular and you can guess what it will be like in the future
entries.example: She makes a consistent effort to study hard.

entries.chinese: 收入 收益
entries.definition: the money that you get from working
entries.example: The company's income has dropped because of poor sales.

entries.chinese: 结构 构造 结构体 大型建筑物 周密安排 精心组织
entries.definition: The structure of something is the way that it is put together
entries.example: The social structure of a class is often very complex.

entries.chinese: 法律允许的 合法的 与法律有关的 法律的 普通法或成文法确认的 神学律法的
entries.definition: If an activity is legal it does not break any laws
entries.example: In Canada, it is perfectly legal for a woman to walk down the street with no shirt on.

entries.chinese: 概念 观念 某主题的 为表达一种想法而创造的 想象 设想
entries.definition: an idea
entries.example: Italy has introduced the concept of "parental leave" – time off work given to either parent to look after the child.

entries.chinese: 计划 方案 配方 处方 公式 方程式
entries.definition: a way to do something or solve a problem that does not change much
entries.example: The formula for converting from kilograms to pounds is

entries.chinese: 部分 散件 部件 节 栏 一部分人
entries.definition: A section of a thing or place is a part of it
entries.example: The police closed one section of the road because of the accident.

entries.chinese: 必需的 规定的 理想的 需要 要求做 规定
entries.definition: The past tense and past participle of require
entries.example: What’s required is a complete reorganization of the system.

entries.chinese: 宪法的 宪法规定的 合乎宪法的 体质的 体格的 本性的
entries.definition: If a law, a right, an action, etc
entries.example: The court ruled that the new law was constitutional and that there was no need for the government to change it.

entries.chinese: 分析 化验分析 心理分析 精神分析 分析报告
entries.definition: If you do an analysis, you study something carefully to understand it
entries.example: We performed a detailed analysis of the relationship between the two companies and believe that they could form a strong partnership.

entries.chinese: 分发 分销 配送 发行 上映 分配
entries.definition: sending or giving out things to several people, companies, places, etc
entries.example: The distribution of the mail was slowed by the snow storm.

entries.chinese: 功能 职责 宴会 典礼 函数 应变量
entries.definition: Something or someone's function is its purpose or its job
entries.example: The army sometimes performs a policing function.

entries.chinese: 地区 区域 场地 地方 领域 面积
entries.definition: a piece of land or space
entries.example: This is the business area of town.

entries.chinese: 靠近 临近 接洽 交谈 对付 处理
entries.definition: If you approach something, you move closer to it
entries.example: We're now approaching the last bus stop. Please move towards the door.

entries.chinese: 角色 作用 职责 罗莱
entries.definition: The role of a person or thing is the job that they do in a certain situation
entries.example: Music plays an important role in the movie.

entries.chinese: 法规 法律 立法 制订法律
entries.definition: the official laws and rules of a government
entries.example: Congress approved several pieces of legislation.

entries.chinese: 表明 标示 象征 暗示 间接提及 示意
entries.definition: If someone indicates something, they point it out or they point to it; they bring your attention to something
entries.example: He indicated on the map how to get to the police station.

entries.chinese: 反应 响应 回复 答复 答案 唱和
entries.definition: some words or actions that happen as a reaction to something else
entries.example: The police response to these problems has been slow and weak

entries.chinese: 一段时间 时期 阶段 时代 纪 课时
entries.definition: a length of time
entries.example: During the first period, Germany scored two goals.

entries.chinese: 背景 环境 上下文 语境
entries.definition: Something's context is the situation that it happens in
entries.example: The actions of a business cannot be fully understood except in the context of a particular organisation.

entries.chinese: 显著的 相当数量的 重要的 意义重大的 别有含义的 意味深长的
entries.definition: If something is significant, it is important, or large, enough to pay attention to or to believe
entries.example: There was a significant drop in the price of gas today, causing drivers to line up at the pumps to fill up.

entries.chinese: 相像的 类似的 相似的 相似之人 顺势药物
entries.definition: If two things are similar, they are almost the same, or the same in many, but not all, ways
entries.example: My sister and I have very similar ideas.

entries.chinese: 社区 社会 群体 界 共同体 归属感
entries.definition: a group of people living in the same area and having a similar background or similar interests
entries.example: Most Libyan policemen were members of the community where they worked.

entries.chinese: 居民 住户 住宿者 住院医生 寄宿制学校学生 特派代表
entries.definition: somebody who lives in a particular area
entries.example: The local residents like the tourism because it creates more jobs for them.

entries.chinese: 范围 界限 视觉 范围 射程 射击距离 一系列
entries.definition: A range of X s
entries.example: We offer you a whole range of clothes, from socks to hats.

entries.chinese: 建造 建筑 创立 构建 构造 结构
entries.definition: the act of building something
entries.example: The workers began construction of the new hospital last week.

entries.chinese: 策略 战略
entries.definition: The plural form of strategy; more than one (kind of) strategy
entries.example: military strategies

entries.chinese: 要素 元素 一伙 天气 基本原理
entries.definition: The elements can be the weather outside, such as wind and rain
entries.example: Business and management elements are built into the course.

entries.chinese: 以前的 先前的 稍前的 过早的 过急的 前科
entries.definition: If something happened at a previous time, it happened before a particular time
entries.example: Last year, we lived in Seoul, but the previous year we were in Moscow.

entries.chinese: 结论 推论 结局 结尾 缔结 商定
entries.definition: A writer or speaker's conclusions are the ideas that they have after thinking about all the important information
entries.example: The study's main conclusion is that more money will not solve the problem.

entries.chinese: 保护措施 安全工作 保安部门 安检处 保障 保证
entries.definition: safety
entries.example: Since the attack, many Americans have lost their feeling of security.

entries.chinese: 方面 方位 面貌
entries.definition: The plural form of aspect; more than one (kind of) aspect
entries.example: Alcoholism affects all aspects of family life.

entries.chinese: 学得 习得 获取 购买 添置 增添物
entries.definition: the act of getting something, often by buying it
entries.example: The judge ruled that the acquisition of XYZ company by Acme Inc. was illegal.

entries.chinese: 产品特点 特征 容貌 嘴脸 是 的特色 使突出
entries.definition: The plural form of feature; more than one (kind of) feature
entries.example: She has small, delicate facial features.

entries.chinese: 正文 文字材料 原文 课本 教科书 文本
entries.definition: written language (often academic)
entries.example: The text is OK, but we need to change the graphics before we publish.

entries.chinese: 考察团 委员会 佣金 回扣 犯罪 委托
entries.definition: a group of people who work together to research or manage something for a government
entries.example: She was recently appointed to head the European commission on climate change.

entries.chinese: 规则 规章 条例 法规
entries.definition: The plural form of regulation; more than one (kind of) regulation
entries.example: There seem to be so many rules and regulations these days.

entries.chinese: 计算机 电脑 电子计算机
entries.definition: a machine that helps you store, organize, and use information
entries.example: If you're looking at a web page, you must be using a computer.

entries.chinese: 项目 条目 新闻 估算 逐条记载
entries.definition: The plural form of item; more than one (kind of) item
entries.example: The store is having a sale on furniture and household items.

entries.chinese: 消费者 顾客 用户 食用者 使用者 消耗者
entries.definition: someone who buys or uses goods or services
entries.example: Selling goods to consumers is known as retail.

entries.chinese: 达到 取得 实现 获得成功
entries.definition: If you achieve success or a goal, you have completed what you planned to do or have a good result
entries.example: She achieved a grade of 98% in her English class.

entries.chinese: 最终的 结束的 最后的 末尾的 决定性的 不可变更的
entries.definition: The final thing is the last one
entries.example: Today is the final day to register for university.

entries.chinese: 乐观的 有信心的 积极的 建设性的 良好的 有助益的
entries.definition: If something is positive, it is good, happy, or wanted
entries.example: The changes in the prices were all positive.

entries.chinese: 评价 评估
entries.definition: the process of making a judgement
entries.example: After the problem was found, we began an internal evaluation of the management.

entries.chinese: 帮助 援助
entries.definition: If you give someone or something assistance, you give help or support
entries.example: The company may also provide financial assistance to single mothers.

entries.chinese: 正常的 标准的 健康的 普通的 正交的 垂直的
entries.definition: A normal thing, or situation, is one that is not special
collocations: it is normal (for somebody) to do something
entries.example: A normal computer has a keyboard and a screen.

entries.chinese: 有关的 切题的 正确的 适宜的 有价值的 有意义的
entries.definition: If something is relevant, it is connected to a topic in a meaningful way
entries.example: The police officers discovered the truth while examining a pile of relevant documents.

entries.chinese: 差别 区分 杰出 卓越 特点 荣誉
entries.definition: a difference that you have noticed or decided is important
entries.example: There is, in other words, no neat or clear distinction to be drawn between political equality and social and economic equality.

entries.chinese: 地区 区域 行政区 地方 身体部位 领域
entries.definition: an area of land or of the body
entries.example: The southern regions of Japan are warm and tropical.

entries.chinese: 传统的 根据传统而制造 的 因袭的 守旧的 惯例的 经常从事的
entries.definition: If something is traditional, it has been done in the same way for a long time
collocations: it is traditional (for somebody) to do something
entries.example: It is traditional to give gifts at Christmas time.

entries.chinese: 撞击 冲击力 巨大影响 强大作用 冲击 挤入
entries.definition: the act of one object hitting another
entries.example: In tests, the driver was unhurt, even in high-speed impacts.

entries.chinese: 后果 结果 影响
entries.definition: The plural form of consequence; more than one (kind of) consequence
entries.example: Our findings have far-reaching consequences for researchers.

entries.chinese: 章 回 篇 阶段 时期 分会
entries.definition: a main division of a book
entries.example: We read chapter five in the blue textbook.

entries.chinese: 等式 方程 等同 复杂局面
entries.definition: a mathematical statement in which both sides are of equal value
entries.example: Using equation (2.1) from above, we can now solve for x {\displaystyle x} .

entries.chinese: 合适的 相称的 拨出 私占 挪用
entries.definition: If something is appropriate, it matches the situation
entries.example: It is the job of management to look at the problems and take appropriate action.

entries.chinese: 资源 物力 向 提供资金
entries.definition: The plural form of resource; more than one (kind of) resource
entries.example: She had no financial resources.

entries.chinese: 参加 参与
entries.definition: the act of joining together with other people to do something
entries.example: After the injury, he was removed from active participation in the war.

entries.chinese: 民意调查 民意测验 考察 调查 全面考察 概述
entries.definition: a broad look at a topic or place
entries.example: Before looking for a job, he did a survey of the companies in the area.

entries.chinese: 潜在的 可能的 潜力 可能性 潜能 电势
entries.definition: A potential customer, benefit, problem, etc
entries.example: To grow, a business must identify potential customers and their needs.

entries.chinese: 文化的 与文化有关的 艺术的 文艺的
entries.definition: A cultural background, difference, identity etc
entries.example: The difference between the cities are both cultural and economic.

entries.chinese: 转移 搬迁 传染 转让 调动 转职
entries.definition: If you transfer (something), you move (it) to a different place
entries.example: We dug up the tree and transferred it to the front of the house.

entries.chinese: 选择 挑选 选定 决定 是否继续存在 精选的 优等的
entries.definition: If you select something, you choose it
entries.example: It wouldn't be too difficult to make the computer select for vague general features like, say, tall-thinness or short-fatness.

entries.chinese: 信用 信贷 赊购 赞扬 信誉 声望
entries.definition: an agreement to buy something and pay later
entries.example: We bought the new dining room table on credit.

entries.chinese: 影响 侵袭 感染 深深打动 震撼 假装
entries.definition: If x , then x
entries.example: The movement of the soccer ball was affected by the wind.

entries.chinese: 类别
entries.definition: The plural form of category; more than one (kind of) category
entries.example: There are five categories of workers.

entries.chinese: 感知到的 感观的 感知 认为 领会
entries.definition: The past tense and past participle of perceive
entries.example: In Japan, smoking while walking is perceived as rude in public places.

entries.chinese: 寻找
entries.definition: The past tense and past participle of seek
entries.example: When she ran into problems, Pam sought advice from an expert.

entries.chinese: 重点 中心点 关注 注意 震源 目的
entries.definition: If you focus on something, you pay special attention to it
entries.example: Class, please focus on your assignment and stop talking.

entries.chinese: 购买 采购 购买的东西 财产置得 紧握 牢牢抓住
entries.definition: If you purchase something, you buy it
entries.example: JEB Fasteners purchased all the shares in the private company for just under $900,000.

entries.chinese: 伤 损害 伤害 挫伤
entries.definition: when someone or an animal is hurt; when something has caused a person or an animal to be harmed
entries.example: She suffered serious injuries to her face and chest in the car crash.

entries.chinese: 工地 用地 地点 现场 场所 场地
entries.definition: a location or a place
entries.example: He was working on a building site in Alton when a concrete mixer rolled back and hit him.

entries.chinese: 杂志 期刊 报纸 日记 日志 日记账
entries.definition: a record of what is happening, usually written regularly (eg, daily, weekly, monthly, etc), often scientific
entries.example: They published their study in the British Medical Journal.

entries.chinese: 主要的 首要的 小学教育的 初级教育的 初级的 原发性的
entries.definition: first
entries.example: Most patients are managed in primary care but the vast majority of research publications derive from hospitals.

entries.chinese: 复杂的 难懂的 组合的 合成的 复合的 复数的
entries.definition: If something is complex, it has lots of parts or pieces, or is difficult to understand
entries.example: A complex problem that we face today is poverty, especially in Africa.

entries.chinese: 研究所 学院 协会 注释 论述 制定
entries.definition: an organisation such as a school or hospital that does teaching or research
entries.example: William Wallace is deputy director of the Royal Institute of International Affairs.

entries.chinese: 投资 值得买的东西 投入 包围 封锁
entries.definition: the use of money, time, or effort to make a profit
entries.example: The economic Development Board, set up in 1961 to promote foreign investment in Singapore, has attracted money from around the world.

entries.chinese: 管理 行政 管理部门 行政部门 政府 执行
entries.definition: the process of running and organising an organisation such as a business or government
entries.example: The mayor is responsible for the administration of the town.

entries.chinese: 维护 保养 保持 维持 生活费 抚养费

entries.definition: You use this to say that something cannot be avoided
entries.example: Inevitably, if you practice less, you will be less good.

entries.chinese: 补充 补足 补足物 衬托物 足数 足额
entries.definition: If x , x complete or whole
entries.example: We believe your addition will complement the team.

entries.chinese: 陪伴 陪同 伴随 与 一起发生 为 伴奏 附带
entries.definition: If one thing accompanies something else, it comes or goes with it, or they happen together
entries.example: Children under 12 must be accompanied by an adult.

entries.chinese: 段 段落 段落符号 短评 把 分段
entries.definition: one or more sentences that are written together with no line breaks separating them
entries.example: She knew what it would say after reading the first paragraph.

entries.chinese: 感应的 诱发型 引诱 说服
entries.definition: The past tense and past participle of induce
entries.example: She had to be induced because the baby was four weeks late.

entries.chinese: 计划 进度表 时间表 清单 一览表 节目表
entries.definition: a plan of things that are happening and the times when they happen
entries.example: The train is right on schedule.

entries.chinese: 强烈 剧烈 强度
entries.definition: The intensity of something is the amount of it in a given time or space
entries.example: These flowers suffer from high intensity of sunlight.

entries.chinese: 至关重要的 决定性的 极好的
entries.definition: When something is crucial, it is very important
entries.example: Iron plays a crucial role in moving oxygen around the body.

entries.chinese: 经由 经过 通过 借助于
entries.definition: You use via to mean the path that something takes when it goes somewhere (the places it goes through before it gets there)
entries.example: John sent the message to Yoko via Hamid.

entries.chinese: 表现出 卖弄 炫耀 提出 展览 展出
entries.definition: You exhibit something when you show it to others
entries.example: He exhibited the new product to the audience.

entries.chinese: 偏见 成见 偏好 天赋 倾向 趋势
entries.definition: a preference in one direction that makes things unequal
entries.example: They had plans for an international centre, with a strong political bias.

entries.chinese: 操纵 推拿 控制 使用 伪造 篡改
entries.definition: the act of controlling someone or something, usually through pressure or in dishonest ways
entries.example: The political manipulation of statistics to confuse people is common.

entries.chinese: 题目 主题 主旋律 主题音乐 主题曲 作文
entries.definition: a general idea that runs through a conversation, story, group of images, piece of music, etc
entries.example: For Mr Giuliani, crime is a main campaign theme.

entries.chinese: 核子的 原子核的 核武器的 原子能的 核能的 核心的
entries.definition: Nuclear weapons, power, waste, etc
entries.example: Most Canadians live in a nuclear family: the husband, wife, and children.

entries.chinese: 主体 大部分 庞大的身躯 肥硕的体形 容积 体积
entries.definition: The bulk of something is the largest part of it
entries.example: The bulk of the shipment was headed for Toronto.

entries.chinese: 代表 因为 为了 的利益 就 而言 在 一方
entries.definition: If you do something on someone's behalf, you do it for them or as their representative
entries.example: We give you this award on behalf of a grateful nation.

entries.chinese: 一致的 统一的 联合的 一体的 联合 统一
entries.definition: If multiple things are unified, they are united into a whole
entries.example: a unified approach

entries.chinese: 开始
entries.definition: The past tense and past participle of commence
entries.example: The planes commenced bombing at midnight.

entries.chinese: 侵蚀 腐蚀 削弱 降低 糜烂
entries.definition: the loss of land because of water and wind
entries.example: Footpath erosion is a significant problem in all the UK's national parks.

entries.chinese: 受期待的 让人期盼的 预期 预料 期待 盼望
entries.definition: The past tense and past participle of anticipate
entries.example: Sales are better than anticipated.

entries.chinese: 极小的 极少的 极简抽象艺术的 简朴的 朴实无华的 极简的
entries.definition: When something is minimal, it is very small or small enough to not be important, especially the smallest
entries.example: Don't worry -- any problems from this will be minimal.

entries.chinese: 停止 终了
entries.definition: The third-person singular form of cease
entries.example: For those above them -- households with over $ 62,000 -- the payroll tax ceases to grow.

entries.chinese: 幻想 想象 幻觉 幻象 构想 展望
entries.definition: being able to see with your eyes
entries.example: Now I'm old and my vision is not very good, so I don't drive a car any more.

entries.chinese: 相互的 彼此的 共同的 共有的 互助的 互助公司
entries.definition: If something is mutual x , and y
entries.example: She hated him, and the feeling was mutual.

entries.chinese: 标准 规范 基准
entries.definition: The plural form of norm; more than one (kind of) norm
entries.example: terrorists who violate the norms of civilized society

entries.chinese: 居中的 中间的 中等程度的 中级的 中级水平者 中级学生
entries.definition: If something is intermediate, it is between other things
entries.example: Most people who get beyond the beginner stage get stuck being intermediate.

entries.chinese: 手工的 体力的 手动的 用手操作的 使用手册 说明书
entries.definition: If something is manual, it is done with the hands or through physical work
entries.example: One quarter of the accidents at work arise from manual lifting, handling and carrying.

entries.chinese: 补充的 附加的 互补的 补充者 增补物 补充提问
entries.definition: If something is supplementary, it is added on; it is not needed, but it is often useful
entries.example: These software solutions are more supplementary than basic.

entries.chinese: 不相容的 不能共存的 不能和谐相处的 合不来的 不兼容的 互斥的
entries.definition: Two things are incompatible with each other if they don't fit together or don't work well together
entries.example: The husband and wife were not happy together because they were incompatible.

entries.chinese: 并存的 同时发生的 同意的 一致的 同时执行的 共点的
entries.definition: If two things are concurrent, they happen at the same time
entries.example: The software can handle up to 500 concurrent users.

entries.chinese: 道德的 伦理的 合乎道德的 有益于人 的 环保的 凭处方出售的
entries.definition: An ethical issue, problem, etc
entries.example: Doctors have to think about both the medical and ethical parts of the problem.

entries.chinese: 初步的 预备的 初步行动 准备工作 预赛 预试
entries.definition: If something is preliminary, it is a preparation for a main matter
entries.example: Preliminary to the main discussions, perhaps we could introduce ourselves.

entries.chinese: 必需的 必要的 不可或缺的 作为组成部分的 完整的 整的
entries.definition: Integral parts, elements, etc
entries.example: Regular training is regarded as integral to management.

entries.chinese: 相反地 反过来说
entries.definition: used to say that one idea is the opposite of the other idea
entries.example: The over-confident driver may drive too fast. Conversely the under-confident person may also cause problems by driving too slowly.

entries.chinese: 放松的 轻松的 舒适的 自在的 不加以拘束的 随便的
entries.definition: If someone is relaxed, they feel calm, they are not worried, and their muscles are not tight
entries.example: I feel most relaxed when I'm fishing.

entries.chinese: 有限的 狭窄的 受限制的 被限定的 受困于 的 幽禁的
entries.definition: If something or someone is confined, it is not free to move about
entries.example: It wasn’t easy to sleep in such a confined space.

entries.chinese: 住宿 膳宿 住处 办公处 停留处 空间
entries.definition: a place to stay or live
entries.example: The hotel provides high quality accommodation, mostly for foreign visitors.

entries.chinese: 暂时的 临时的 短期的 短暂的 临时雇员 临时工
entries.definition: Something is temporary if it's only for a short time
entries.example: A tent was our temporary home after our house burned down in the fire.

entries.chinese: 变形的 扭曲的 受到曲解的 失真的 使变形 使变样
entries.definition: The past tense and past participle of distort
entries.example: His account was badly distorted by the press.

entries.chinese: 消极的 被动的 被动语态的 非暴力的 无源的 经表面钝化处理的
entries.definition: If someone is passive, they do not normally respond or take action
entries.example: Watching TV is a much more passive activity than reading.

entries.chinese: 从属的 下级的 次要的 部属 下级 从属
entries.definition: If something is subordinate, it is less important than someone or something else
entries.example: In society a dominant group often ignores the wishes of subordinate groups.

entries.chinese: 相似的 类似的 同功的
entries.definition: When x , it is similar to y
entries.example: The development of the new DVD with multiple formats is analogous to the video wars between beta and VHS.

entries.chinese: 军事的 军队的 陆军的 军人般的 军人作风的 军人
entries.definition: If something is military, it is a characteristic of people in the armed forces
entries.example: Sick soldiers go to the military hospital.

entries.chinese: 设想 可能发生的情况 剧情梗概 场景
entries.definition: a possible or imagined future, often with detailed plans
entries.example: If the first part can be completed, then two possible scenarios present themselves.

entries.chinese: 彻底变革 革命 旋转 旋转一周 共产主义革命 循环
entries.definition: a sudden significant change
entries.example: In the 1960s, you had the women's revolution, the sexual revolution, and all sorts of change.

entries.chinese: 减减弱 降低 减少 贬低 轻视
entries.definition: If something is diminished, it is lessened; it is reduced
entries.example: Her energy was diminished after she ran five miles.

entries.chinese: 连贯性 条理性 凝聚 凝聚力
entries.definition: the property of being connected, especially of ideas
entries.example: We studied loneliness and coherence among Children with learning problems.

entries.chinese: 悬挂 停止 暂停 中止 暂令停职 暂令停学
entries.definition: If something is suspended, it is stopped for a while
entries.example: Sales of the drug will be suspended until more tests are completed.

entries.chinese: 成熟的 理智的 成年的 发育完全的 发酵成熟的 酿成的
entries.definition: Someone is mature if they act like an adult
entries.example: You're not mature enough to do this job.

entries.chinese: 自信 把握 保险 保证 确保
entries.definition: a strong promise, usually given when the listener has doubts
entries.example: She had been here before and could give assurance that they were on the right course.

entries.chinese: 严格死板的 僵化的 顽固的 不通融的 刚硬的 不易弯曲的
entries.definition: A rigid object does not bend
entries.example: It's possible to use flexible materials to form a rigid structure.

entries.chinese: 争论 争议
entries.definition: When there is a controversy about something, people don't agree about it and there is a lot of talking about it
entries.example: Newspapers love to write about controversies.

entries.chinese: 范围 领域 球体 球 球形 社会阶层
entries.definition: a shape that is round in all directions, like a ball
entries.example: The Earth is almost exactly a sphere.

entries.chinese: 调解 仲裁
entries.definition: the process of helping two people or groups who are not in agreement to come to an agreement
entries.example: When I was separated from my wife, we had mediation to help decide who got to keep the house.

entries.chinese: 总体安排 计划 设计 开本 版式 格式
entries.definition: The format of some writing is the way it is organized: the size and colour of the letters, the way it is divided into parts, the kind of words used
entries.example: What format do you want the report written in?

entries.chinese: 扳机 起因 诱因 引爆器 触发器 引发
entries.definition: the part of a gun that you push with one finger when you want to make the gun shoot
entries.example: I didn't want to make him angry, because he had his finger on the trigger.

entries.chinese: 质量的 定性的 性质的
entries.definition: A reason, idea or writing is qualitative if it is about the way something is, or about the thing's qualities, but not about amounts
entries.example: I have a qualitative idea of what his work is like, but I don't know how much work he's done.

entries.chinese: 一部分 一份 一客 一份财产 命运 天数
entries.definition: a part of something
entries.example: We need to put more signs up in this portion of the city.

entries.chinese: 媒介 媒体 方法 手段 材料 素材
entries.definition: A medium amount is an amount that is not small and not large, but in the middle
entries.example: Would you like a small, medium or large drink?

entries.chinese: 巧合 同时发生 一致 相符 相交 重叠
entries.definition: Two things coincide with each other if they're both in the same place or at the same time
entries.example: The time of your party coincides with my niece's wedding, so I can't come.

entries.chinese: 违背 违反 侵权行为 侵犯 损毁 亵渎
entries.definition: A violation of a rule is an act of breaking the rule: going past the limits of the rule
entries.example: This violation of our trust cannot be forgiven.

entries.chinese: 装置 设备 手段 方法 花招 诡计
entries.definition: a small machine or tool
entries.example: She has a device in her kitchen for cutting garlic.

entries.chinese: 洞察力 眼力 深刻见解
entries.definition: The plural form of insight; more than one (kind of) insight
entries.example: The research provides new insights into the way we process language.

entries.chinese: 精炼 提纯 改进 改善 使 文雅
entries.definition: When someone refines something, they make it better
entries.example: We need to refine our way of organizing this office.

entries.chinese: 挚爱的 忠诚的 热衷的 专用于 的 献身 致力
entries.definition: If someone is devoted, they are dedicated or loyal
entries.example: Joanne is a very devoted wife.

entries.chinese: 队 小组 工作队 工作组 一组牲口 协作
entries.definition: a group of people who play or work together on the same side
entries.example: The operation was performed by a medical team led by Dr. Wood.

entries.chinese: 互搭 复叠 部分地重叠 部分相同 同时发生 重叠部分
entries.definition: Something overlaps on another thing if part of it is on top of, or at the same time as, the other thing
entries.example: The shingles of a roof need to overlap to keep rain out.

entries.chinese: 取得 得到 获得
entries.definition: The past tense and past participle of attain
entries.example: Share prices attained a high of $3.27.

entries.chinese: 限制 禁止
entries.definition: The plural form of restraint; more than one (kind of) restraint
entries.example: Opposition politicians have called for restraints on public spending.

entries.chinese: 内在的 固有的 固定属于 的 作定语和表语时意义相同的
entries.definition: A part of something that is natural and cannot be separated from it
entries.example: Everybody understands the inherent value of education.

entries.chinese: 路线 航线 道路 路途 常规路线 固定路线
entries.definition: the way someone goes from one place to another place
entries.example: Could you tell me a route to the store from here?

entries.chinese: 礼仪 礼节 国际议定书 协议 条约草案 附件
entries.definition: a rule, guideline, or document about how certain activities are done
entries.example: I don't know the protocol for talking to the President.

entries.chinese: 有基础的 建立 创立
entries.definition: The past tense and past participle of found
entries.example: Who originally founded the college?

entries.chinese: 持续 持续时间
entries.definition: The time something takes, or how much time it takes
entries.example: The duration of this event will be three hours.

entries.chinese: 凭此 借以 与 一致 在 的情况下 处于 的位置
entries.definition: by which; because of which
entries.example: Learning is the method whereby we improve our minds.

entries.chinese: 倾向 意愿 趋向 趋势 斜坡 斜度
entries.definition: Someone has an inclination to do something if the person wants to do it or often does it
entries.example: I have an inclination to eat some ice cream right now.

entries.chinese: 遇到 曾遭遇
entries.definition: The past tense and past participle of encounter
entries.example: They encountered serious problems when two members of the expedition were injured.

entries.chinese: 确信的 信服的 坚信不疑的 有坚定信仰的 使确信 使信服
entries.definition: If you are convinced of something, you believe it strongly
entries.example: Last year I became convinced that we had been wrong all along.

entries.chinese: 议会 代表大会 集会 集会者 装配 组装
entries.definition: A group of people who came together for an event
entries.example: She stood in front of the assembly and started to talk.

entries.chinese: 虽然 尽管 艾乐贝特
entries.definition: You use albeit to give more information that weakens earlier information
entries.example: He won the fight, albeit barely.

entries.chinese: 巨大的 极大的 凶暴的 极恶的
entries.definition: Huge; very big; very large
entries.example: Elephants are enormous animals.

entries.chinese: 勉强的 不情愿的
entries.definition: If you are reluctant to do something, you do not want to do it
entries.example: She gave him a reluctant smile.

entries.chinese: 形成 摆姿势 主张 装模作样
entries.definition: The past tense and past participle of pose
entries.example: We posed for photographs.

entries.chinese: 执意的 坚持不懈的 持续的 反复出现的 作用持久的 挥发慢的
entries.definition: If someone or something is persistent, they continue and do not give up quickly
entries.example: She has had a persistent cough for weeks.

entries.chinese: 经历 经受
entries.definition: If you undergo something, it happens to you; often it is not nice
entries.example: She had to undergo surgery because of her broken leg.

entries.chinese: 虽然 尽管 尽管如此
entries.definition: If something is true notwithstanding something else, it is true in spite of that other thing
entries.example: Notwithstanding, the problem is a significant one.

entries.chinese: 简单的 易懂的 诚实的 坦率的 直截了当地 坦率地
entries.definition: If something is straightforward, it is simple
entries.example: Making tea is pretty straightforward.

entries.chinese: 专家咨询组 专题讨论小组 镶板 嵌板 控制板 仪表盘
entries.definition: a flat piece of wood or other material, used as part of a wall or on the side of something
entries.example: The house has aluminium panels covering the outside.

entries.chinese: 奇怪的 反常的 偶然出现的 偶尔发生的 奇形怪状的 各种各样的
entries.definition: If something is odd, it is not normal and usually you don't like it or don't understand it
entries.example: She liked him, but there was something odd about the way he spoke.

entries.chinese: 内在的 固有的
entries.definition: x if x
entries.example: Being able to think is intrinsic to being human.

entries.chinese: 汇编 编纂 编译 收集 搜集
entries.definition: The past tense and past participle of compile
entries.example: The document was compiled by the Department of Health

entries.chinese: 邻近的 毗连的 相邻的
entries.definition: If x , there is no other thing between x
entries.example: The house has an adjacent garage.

entries.chinese: 正直 诚实 完整 完全 职业操守 集成度
entries.definition: the quality of being honest and of doing only good things
entries.example: I liked the integrity she showed when she wouldn't let someone from the other company pay for her lunch.

entries.chinese: 即将发生的 乐于提供信息的 愿意提供帮助的 现成的 可得到的 来临
entries.definition: An event that is forthcoming is something that will happen soon
entries.example: The forthcoming publication of her book will help her get status and respect.

entries.chinese: 构思 设想 怀孕
entries.definition: The past tense and past participle of conceive
entries.example: Language may be conceived of as a process which arises from social interaction.

entries.chinese: 持续存在的 仍在进行的 不断发展的
entries.definition: Something is ongoing if it's continuing to happen without stopping in one long period of time
entries.example: The growth of bones is still ongoing at age 12.

entries.chinese: 所谓的 叫做 的 号称 的
entries.definition: When someone uses the word "so-called" to talk about something, they mean that other people talk about the thing that way, but they don't agree
entries.example: When are we going to leave this so-called party?

entries.chinese: 同样地 类似地 我也是 我有同感 也 还
entries.definition: When someone does something likewise, they do it the same way someone else did it
entries.example: "I'm happy to see you!" "Likewise!"

entries.chinese: 然而 尽管如此
entries.definition: , (formal) When x is true, then x from being true
entries.example: It's raining, but we're going to eat outside nonetheless.

entries.chinese: 征收 扣押财产 征兵 发动 征收额 税款
entries.definition: If you levy a charge or a tax, you legally make people pay it
entries.example: The government levies a tax on all wood entering the country.

entries.chinese: 叫唤
entries.definition: When a rule is invoked, it is being used in a specific situation
entries.example: That rule was not invoked during that meeting.

entries.chinese: 同事 同行
entries.definition: The plural form of colleague; more than one (kind of) colleague
entries.example: The teacher talked to his colleagues.

entries.chinese: 抑郁 沮丧 萧条 不景气 低气压 凹陷
entries.definition: If someone has depression, they have a condition which makes them very sad and makes it very hard for them to imagine being happy later
entries.example: After Suzie's dog passed away, she fell into a depression for six months.

entries.chinese: 倒塌 塌下 崩溃 瓦解 突然倒下 昏倒
entries.definition: Something collapses when all its parts fall down loosely
entries.example: The bridge collapsed, but no one was hurt.
